title: Targeting the sirtuin 6-NF-kappaB p65 axis by 6-hydroxyhyoscyamine hydrobromide: a deacetylation-driven new therapy for diabetic wounds.
authors: Chen, Junren; Qin, Siqi; Xing, Ziwei; Wan, Feng; Yin, Jie; Peng, Cheng; Li, Dan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究6-HH通过SIRT6-NF-kB p65轴促进糖尿病伤口愈合，虽涉及分子对接和蛋白-DNA互作（p65转录），但核心是药物机制与湿实验，非TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Diabetic wounds are a debilitating complication of diabetes mellitus with a high rate of amputation and mortality. 6-Hydroxyhyoscyamine hydrobromide (6-HH) is a belladonna alkaloid with smooth-muscle-relaxing and microcirculation-enhancing properties, yet its role in diabetic wounds remains unknown. METHODS: In vivo, diabetic wounds were established in streptozotocin (STZ)-induced type 1 diabetic mice, high fat diet (HFD)/STZ-induced type 2 diabetic mice, and db/db diabetic mice to investigate the therapeutic effects of 6-HH, and skin samples were collected for hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) and Masson's trichrome staining, immunofluorescence, RNA-seq analysis, and western blotting. In vitro, the mechanism of action of 6-HH on cytokines, nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) signals, and the interaction between sirtuin 6 (SIRT6) and p65 in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced macrophages were detected by using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), western blotting, reverse-transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), immunofluorescence, and immunoprecipitation, while molecular docking was used to evaluate the binding energy between 6-HH and SIRT6 protein. Coculture systems of THP-1 cells-human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs)/immortalized human keratinocytes (HaCaTs) were established to investigate the effects of 6-HH on cross-talk between macrophages and endothelial cells/keratinocytes. SIRT6-specific inhibitor Oss_128167 was applied in vitro and in vivo to verify the mechanism of 6-HH in diabetic wound healing. RESULTS: 6-HH exhibited excellent pro-healing effect in the three types of diabetic mouse model. RNA-seq analysis found that 6-HH recovered diabetic-induced aberrant expression changes of genes in the local wounds, especially those related to M1 macrophage polarization with downregulation of Toll-like receptor (TLR) signals and nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADP+) nucleosidase activity. Molecular docking analysis found that 6-HH could effectively bind to the active site of the SIRT6 protein. Remarkably, decline of SIRT6 in M1 macrophages resulted in lysine hyperacetylation, while activation and stabilization of SIRT6 by 6-HH suppressed M1 macrophage polarization and hyperacetylation through inhibiting p65 transcription with deacetylation of p65Lys310 and H3K9, contributing to improve angiogenesis and re-epithelization through interaction between macrophages and endothelial cells/keratinocytes. However, pharmacological inhibition of SIRT6 reversed the action of 6-HH in macrophages and diabetic wounds. CONCLUSIONS: Collectively, deacetylase SIRT6 might be a direct pharmacological target of 6-HH that downregulates the hyperacetylated state of macrophages, thus contributing to diabetic wound healing.
abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病创面是糖尿病的一种致残性并发症，具有高截肢率和高死亡率。6-羟基莨菪碱氢溴酸盐（6-HH）是一种颠茄生物碱，具有平滑肌松弛和改善微循环的特性，但其在糖尿病创面中的作用尚不清楚。方法：在体内，通过链脲佐菌素（STZ）诱导的1型糖尿病小鼠、高脂饮食（HFD）/STZ诱导的2型糖尿病小鼠以及db/db糖尿病小鼠建立糖尿病创面模型，以研究6-HH的治疗效果，并收集皮肤样本进行苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色、Masson三色染色、免疫荧光、RNA-seq分析和蛋白质印迹。在体外，通过酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）、蛋白质印迹、逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）、免疫荧光和免疫沉淀检测6-HH对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的巨噬细胞中细胞因子、核因子κB（NF-κB）信号以及sirtuin 6（SIRT6）与p65之间相互作用的作用机制，同时使用分子对接评估6-HH与SIRT6蛋白之间的结合能。建立THP-1细胞-人脐静脉内皮细胞（HUVECs）/永生化人角质形成细胞（HaCaTs）的共培养系统，以研究6-HH对巨噬细胞与内皮细胞/角质形成细胞间串扰的影响。在体外和体内应用SIRT6特异性抑制剂Oss_128167，以验证6-HH在糖尿病创面愈合中的作用机制。结果：6-HH在三种糖尿病小鼠模型中表现出优异的促愈合效果。RNA-seq分析发现，6-HH恢复了糖尿病诱导的局部创面基因异常表达变化，特别是与M1巨噬细胞极化相关的基因，并下调Toll样受体（TLR）信号和烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸（NADP+）核苷酸酶活性。分子对接分析发现，6-HH能有效结合SIRT6蛋白的活性位点。值得注意的是，M1巨噬细胞中SIRT6的下降导致赖氨酸过度乙酰化，而6-HH对SIRT6的激活和稳定通过抑制p65转录及去乙酰化p65Lys310和H3K9，抑制了M1巨噬细胞极化和过度乙酰化，从而通过巨噬细胞与内皮细胞/角质形成细胞间的相互作用促进血管生成和再上皮化。然而，药理学抑制SIRT6逆转了6-HH在巨噬细胞和糖尿病创面中的作用。结论：总体而言，去乙酰化酶SIRT6可能是6-HH的直接药理学靶点，通过下调巨噬细胞的过度乙酰化状态，从而促进糖尿病创面愈合。
